name: xiao-s3-sense
title: Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 Sense
notes: Wi-Fi as it ships; wired with a W5500 module on the SD card's bus: CS D0 (GPIO1), INT D1 (GPIO2), RST D3 (GPIO4). The user LED shares GPIO21 with the SD card's chip select: use an add-on LED. At 20 dBm transmit, packets were lost and the access point dropped it for low ACK; 15 dBm measured clean.
